name: SPT-WF / Tui Samoa cable landing station and telecom core (Mata-Utu, Wallis)
developer: SPT-WF (Service des Postes et Télécommunications de Wallis et Futuna); AFD/EU-funded Tui Samoa cable project
notes: Tui Samoa submarine cable branch terminates at Mata-Utu (Uvea); SPT-WF states TUI-SAMOA effective from April 2018; AFD project page (start 2016-11-16, EUR 13m) covers branch to Wallis and Futuna, terminal equipment and maintenance. Telecom cable station / telecom core facility per WF methodology - not a commercial colocation or named government data center (no A-grade evidence of either). SPT-WF THD/FTTH deployment serves grands comptes (admin/enterprise) across Uvea but is connectivity-only.

name: Tui Samoa Futuna cable landing station (Leava, Futuna)
developer: SPT-WF; Tui Samoa cable system (SSCC/consortium with AFD/EU funding for WF branch)
notes: AFD (A) and La 1ère (B) confirm a Futuna landing station installed (Oct-Nov 2017) and operational with Tui Samoa (RFS April 2018 per SPT-WF); village-level placement at Leava (Sigave precinct, north-west Futuna) per GeoCables cable tracker (C). Classified telecom_cable_station per WF methodology; Leava SPT service point itself is not a data center. No commercial colo or named government DC evidence in Sigave.

Division sweep (Alo/Ono/Mala'e + centre de données/datacenter/hébergement/serveur/informatique, French-primary) found no datacenter project, colocation facility, named government DC or cable landing station in Alo (southern Futuna). Only connectivity/access services (SPT-WF FTTH, satellite/VSAT, village public services) exist per WF methodology; no A/B-grade facility evidence.
